```yaml
name: Rebuild Model Site on Release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  rebuild-model-site:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Trigger Vercel Rebuild
        run: |
          curl -X POST "${{ secrets.MODEL_SITE_DEPLOY_HOOK }}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"ref": "master"}'
```

name: Rebuild Model Site on Release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  rebuild-model-site:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Trigger Vercel Rebuild
